🎉 NEVER MISS WHAT’S HAPPENING THIS WEEKEND IN THE GRAND VALLEY! 🏔️✨

We’re excited to officially launch our brand-new "Grand Valley Weekend Roundup" on Explore Mesa County!

Starting every Thursday, our platform automatically curates a fresh, easy-to-read list of everything going on across Mesa County from Thursday through Sunday.

Whether you’re looking for:
🎵 Live Music & Local Gigs

🍎 Farmers Markets & Food Trucks

🏆 Community Fundraisers & School Sports

🎨 Family Activities & Artisan Pop-Ups

We’ve got it all listed in one convenient spot! No more hunting through dozens of different pages to plan your weekend.

Doughbra’s Stand is back this weekend 9/20/26 rain or shine!

A little rain isn’t stopping us! We’ll have the stand covered and ready to go, so you can stay dry while you stock up on your sourdough favorites.

This week, you’ll find traditional artisan sourdough, soft sandwich loaves, our Mini Soft Loaf Trio, dinner rolls, bread bowls, sourdough chocolate chip cookies, Cheese Its, tortillas, and more, plus this week’s specialty flavors: Maple Butter and Sun-Dried Tomato, Garlic & Rosemary.

Preorders close TONIGHT, so get those orders in if there’s something you definitely don’t want to miss. But don’t worry if you don’t preorder. I’ll be making lots of extra goodies for the stand this weekend!
